 Policies
 Draft templates for a small Indian e-commerce business | Version 1.0 | 31 August 2026
Important: These are business-ready sample policies, not legal advice. Have an Indian
employment/e-commerce lawyer review them before publishing or using them as binding contractual
documents. Adapt them to your entity type, state, workforce, marketplace rules, GST position and applicable
consumer/employment laws.
1. Samp

le HR Policy
1.1 Purpose
This policy establishes general workplace expectations for Favshop employees, consultants and authorised
team members. It is intended to support a respectful, productive, safe and customer-focused workplace.
1.2 Working Hours & Attendance
Normal working hours will be communicated in the employee’s offer letter or team schedule. Employees are
expected to be punctual, maintain attendance records where required, and inform their manager as early as
possible about unavoidabl

e absence or delay. Operational teams may follow shift-based schedules.
1.3 Leave
Leave should normally be requested in advance through the company’s designated process. Emergency or
sick leave should be communicated as soon as reasonably possible. Leave eligibility, carry-forward, holidays
and statutory benefits will be governed by the applicable law and the employee’s employment terms.
1.4 Code of Conduct
Employees must act honestly, protect company and customer information, avoid conflicts of

interest, treat
colleagues and customers respectfully, and follow reasonable security, safety and operational instructions.
Fraud, harassment, discrimination, theft, deliberate misuse of company systems, unauthorised disclosure of
confidential information and serious misconduct may result in disciplinary action, subject to applicable law
and due process.
1.5 Confidentiality & Data Protection
Customer data, supplier pricing, product research, passwords, source code, business plans and non-public

financial information must be treated as confidential. Employees must access personal data only for
legitimate business purposes and follow company security procedures.
1.6 Remote Work & Company Devices
Where remote work is permitted, employees must maintain a suitable working environment and protect
company information. Company devices, credentials and accounts must not be shared without
authorisation.
1.7 Performance & Disciplinary Process
Performance may be reviewed periodically against role

expectations and agreed objectives. Depending on
the circumstances, performance or conduct concerns may lead to coaching, written warnings, a
performance-improvement process or other lawful action.
1.8 Grievances
Employees may raise workplace concerns with their manager, HR or the designated grievance contact.
Complaints will be handled as confidentially as reasonably possible, subject to legal and operational
requirements.
1.9 Policy Changes

2. Sample Return & Refund Policy
2.1 Scope
This sample policy applies to eligible physical products purchased through Favshop’s own store. Marketplace
orders placed on Amazon, Flipkart or another marketplace remain subject to that marketplace’s applicable
return/refund rules where those rules control the transaction.
2.2 Damaged / Wrong / Missing Item
If the customer receives a damaged, defective, materially different or incomplete item, the customer sh

ould
contact support within the period stated on the product/order page and provide the order number plus clear
photographs or video where reasonably requested. Favshop may arrange replacement, refund or another
remedy after verification.
2.3 Change-of-Mind Returns
Change-of-mind returns may be accepted only for products specifically marked as returnable. Consumables,
opened hygiene-sensitive products, personalised products and products that cannot reasonably be resold
may be excluded where perm

itted by law and clearly disclosed before purchase.
2.4 Return Condition
Returned products should be unused where applicable, complete with accessories and packaging, and
accompanied by the order details. Products showing misuse, alteration or damage caused after delivery may
be rejected where legally permissible.
2.5 Refunds
Approved refunds will normally be processed to the original payment method or through the method
available for the order. Processing time may depend on the payment provider

or bank. Shipping charges,
platform charges or other amounts will be handled according to the applicable order terms and law.
2.6 Non-returnable / Special Products
The final website policy should list exclusions product-by-product rather than relying on a broad statement.
For devotional goods, pay particular attention to consumables such as incense, camphor, oils, wicks and
opened puja materials.
2.7 Cancellation
Orders may be cancelled before dispatch where the order system permits cancellatio

n. Once dispatched,
cancellation may no longer be available and the customer may need to use the applicable return process.
2.8 Fraud / Abuse
Favshop may investigate unusual return patterns, suspected misuse, counterfeit claims or fraudulent
requests and may take lawful action consistent with applicable consumer-protection requirements.

3. Sample Terms & Conditions
3.1 General
These terms govern use of the Favshop website and purchase of products offered through it. By using the
website or placing an order, the customer agrees to the applicable terms, subject to rights that cannot
lawfully be excluded.
3.2 Product Information
Favshop aims to keep product descriptions, images, prices, availability and specifications accurate. Minor
differences may occur due to screen settings, packaging

updates, manufacturing variations or supplier
changes. Material inaccuracies will be addressed in accordance with applicable law.
3.3 Pricing & Orders
Prices may change before an order is placed. An order is subject to acceptance and availability. If an obvious
pricing or listing error occurs, Favshop may contact the customer before fulfilment and provide an
appropriate lawful remedy.
3.4 Payments
Payments must be made using the payment methods offered at checkout. Favshop does not ask customer

s
to disclose card PINs, CVVs, passwords or one-time passwords through unofficial channels.
3.5 Shipping
Estimated delivery dates are indicative unless a guaranteed delivery commitment is expressly provided.
Delivery may be affected by carrier delays, weather, public events, address issues or other circumstances
outside reasonable control.
3.6 Intellectual Property
Favshop-owned logos, original graphics, text, product photography and website content may not be copied,
reproduced or commercially

exploited without permission. Third-party brands, trademarks and copyrighted
materials remain the property of their respective owners.
3.7 User Accounts
Customers are responsible for keeping account credentials secure and for providing accurate information.
Favshop may suspend or close accounts where permitted by law in cases of misuse, fraud or security risk.
3.8 Limitation & Compliance
Nothing in these terms is intended to remove or reduce any consumer right or legal protection that cannot
be

excluded under applicable law. Any limitation of liability should be reviewed by legal counsel before
publication.
3.9 Governing Law & Disputes
The final version should specify the governing law, dispute-resolution mechanism and jurisdiction after legal
review, taking into account applicable Indian consumer and e-commerce requirements.
3.10 Contact
Customer support: [support@yourdomain.com] | Phone: [phone] | Business address: [registered/business
address]. Replace placeholders before publishing

.
4. Recommended website policy set
For a live Favshop store, keep separate pages for: Privacy Policy • Shipping & Delivery •
Return/Refund/Cancellation • Terms & Conditions • Contact/Grievance details • Cookie/consent information
where applicable. Do not publish this draft unchanged without inserting your actual business details and
having the final language reviewed.
